title: Crafting Interstellar Trade and Economics in Your World
use_cases: Use when creating a dynamic trading system between star systems to reflect realistic commerce.
Implement when balancing resource scarcity across regions to influence player strategy.
Configure when setting tariff rates for imported goods to manage interstellar politics.
Use when calculating cargo transport costs based on fuel consumption and ship mass.
Deploy when simulating market fluctuations caused by diplomatic agreements and trade wars.
